Title: Azure SQL Database Managed Instance name change and GUID migration

Body.Content:
Region names and resource GUIDs for Managed Instance General Purpose SQL License were changed on September 27, 2018. The changes happened automatically. They affected only region names and resource GUIDs and did not affect pricing or how your Managed Instance General Purpose SQL License operates. If you have any billing routines that rely on region names or resource GUIDs, you will need to modify them.

See the following table for details about the name change and GUID migration.
